interpretation_policy: Use a legible machine plate explicitly labeled manufacture date/year or a manufacturer-confirmed build record matched to the full model and serial.
Preserve original date text; normalize only its unambiguous precision. A blank plate illustration is not a per-machine observation.
Do not apply passenger-car VIN year tables, serial prefixes or recurring letter cycles without brand/model/serial-scope documentation.

Keep model year, production/launch range, sale/registration year, shipment/service/warranty dates, binding/online timestamps, revision/publication dates and battery/engine/hose dates in separate fields.
Model-based manuals and parts lookups are not automatically manufacture-date lookup tools. Login-link presence is not proof of available date data.
All unsupported year fields remain null. No external outreach or account sign-in was performed.
